name: Limburg an der Lahn (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and blue, charged above the centre with the city arms of Limburg an der Lahn (a castle with towers on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Limburg an der Lahn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
